title: Predicting topological entanglement entropy in a Rydberg analogue simulator
abstract: Proposes time-dependent correlated ansatz for dynamical preparation of quantum-spin-liquid states on Rydberg atom simulators. Enables access to topological entanglement entropy. Uses Rydberg blockade mechanism to engineer target states. Nature Physics 2025.
key_claims: Rydberg blockade mechanism enables topological entanglement entropy measurement
Correlated ansatz captures quantum-spin-liquid ground state features
Topological entanglement entropy accessible in near-term Rydberg hardware
